title: Service: git-vouch-trqp HTTP endpoint
description: Separate executable, Python stdlib only (http.server), stateless: POST /authorization validates the TRQP request against the TRQP JSON schema, maps action->minimum tier per the decision bead, calls 'git vouch query', returns the TRQP response (authorized, time_requested, time_evaluated, message) and TRQP error responses per spec §Error Handling. Recognition endpoint returns a spec-conformant 'not supported' or minimal answer. Public data: no auth. Wire format per the spike (plain TRQP and/or Trust Task envelope). TLS terminated by a reverse proxy.
acceptance_criteria: Request/response validated against the TRQP JSON schemas from the ToIP spec repo (independent oracle); malformed input returns spec errors, never a 500 trace; no registry value reaches a shell.
notes: Review round fixed (uncommitted): proof -> proofInvalid/422; blank context.time = now; RFC3339 re.ASCII; --at year zero-padded (years <1000 answered, not 503); BoundedSemaphore(4) cap on concurrent git vouch query (busy -> 503 retryable; caching is vouch-faq3.6); schema oracle now mandatory (3.9 gate: uv run --python 3.9 --with pytest --with jsonschema --with referencing); tests for internalError boundary, cap, all above. tests/trqp 130 pass on 3.12 and 3.9; ruff clean. REMAINING: blocked on vouch-faq3.10 (Mark: should query --at bound tiers/automation by start date; as built a bot-era signature by a since-promoted handle is authorized for an earlier context.time). After the decision add the hand-written promotion-after-TIME test, then close and commit git-vouch-trqp + tests/trqp/.
